name: Information Retrieval
description: How search engines work: indexing, ranking models, evaluation, web search, recommenders and neural retrieval.

nodes.name: IR basics
nodes.desc: Documents, queries, relevance and Boolean retrieval.
nodes.summary: You will understand the core retrieval problem of matching queries to relevant documents and be able to answer Boolean queries.

nodes.name: Inverted index
nodes.desc: Building posting lists and answering queries by merging them.
nodes.summary: You will be able to build an inverted index of posting lists and answer queries efficiently by merging those lists.

nodes.name: Text processing
nodes.desc: Tokenisation, normalisation and stemming choices for indexing.
nodes.summary: You will be able to choose tokenisation, normalisation and stemming steps for an index and predict their effect on recall and precision.

nodes.name: Index compression
nodes.desc: Gap encoding, variable-byte and other posting list compression.
nodes.summary: You will be able to shrink posting lists with gap encoding and variable-length codes while keeping decoding fast.

nodes.name: Query processing
nodes.desc: Boolean, phrase, positional and wildcard queries.
nodes.summary: You will be able to evaluate Boolean, phrase, positional and wildcard queries using the right index structures.

nodes.name: Vector space model
nodes.desc: TF-IDF weighting and cosine similarity ranking.
nodes.summary: You will be able to rank documents by representing queries and documents as TF-IDF vectors and scoring them with cosine similarity.

nodes.name: BM25
nodes.desc: The probabilistic relevance framework and the BM25 scoring function.
nodes.summary: You will understand the probabilistic relevance framework and be able to compute and tune BM25 scores for documents.

nodes.name: Query likelihood
nodes.desc: Language-model retrieval with smoothing.
nodes.summary: You will be able to rank documents by the likelihood of generating the query under a smoothed document language model.

nodes.name: Mini search engine
nodes.desc: Build a search engine over a document collection with BM25 ranking.
nodes.summary: You will build a working search engine over a document collection with an inverted index and BM25 ranking.

nodes.name: IR evaluation
nodes.desc: Precision, recall, MAP and nDCG.
nodes.summary: You will be able to measure retrieval quality with set-based and ranked metrics such as precision, recall, MAP and nDCG.

nodes.name: Relevance feedback
nodes.desc: Rocchio, pseudo-relevance feedback and query expansion.
nodes.summary: You will be able to improve queries using explicit or pseudo-relevance feedback and query expansion.

nodes.name: Test collections
nodes.desc: TREC-style collections, pooling, online A/B tests and interleaving.
nodes.summary: You will understand how test collections are built and how offline judgments compare with online A/B tests and interleaving.

nodes.name: Web crawling
nodes.desc: Crawler design, politeness, freshness and duplicate detection.
nodes.summary: You will be able to design a web crawler that respects politeness, prioritises freshness and detects duplicate pages.

nodes.name: Link analysis
nodes.desc: PageRank and HITS for ranking pages by link structure.
nodes.summary: You will be able to rank web pages by link structure using PageRank and HITS and compute them iteratively.

nodes.name: Learning to rank
nodes.desc: Pointwise, pairwise and listwise ranking models.
nodes.summary: You will be able to train ranking models from features and relevance labels using pointwise, pairwise and listwise approaches.

nodes.name: Distributed indexing
nodes.desc: Sharding and replicating indexes and query fan-out.
nodes.summary: You will understand how large indexes are partitioned and replicated across machines and how queries fan out and merge.

nodes.name: Recommenders
nodes.desc: Collaborative filtering and matrix factorisation for recommendations.
nodes.summary: You will be able to build recommendation models with collaborative filtering and matrix factorisation and evaluate them.

nodes.name: Dense retrieval
nodes.desc: Dual-encoder models that embed queries and documents.
nodes.summary: You will understand how dual-encoder models embed queries and documents into one vector space for semantic retrieval.

nodes.name: Vector search
nodes.desc: Approximate nearest neighbour search with HNSW and product quantisation.
nodes.summary: You will be able to search millions of embeddings quickly with approximate nearest neighbour indexes such as HNSW and product quantisation.

nodes.name: Neural re-ranking
nodes.desc: Cross-encoder re-rankers and retrieve-then-rerank pipelines.
nodes.summary: You will be able to improve rankings with cross-encoder re-rankers in a retrieve-then-rerank pipeline.

nodes.name: Hybrid search
nodes.desc: Combine BM25 and dense retrieval with re-ranking and evaluate the gains.
nodes.summary: You will build a hybrid search system combining BM25 and dense retrieval with re-ranking and measure the improvement.
topics: Score fusion and reciprocal rank fusion
